The final chapter · Just for you

My Baby Yen, ♡

✦ ♡ ✦

Happy second anniversary, my love.

I know that, especially in the beginning, I gave you a lot of downs. We've had our ups, and there have been downs in between, too. I know things haven't always been easy, and I don't want to pretend that they have.

But here's what I want you to know: I plan to give you more ups, and then more ups, and more reasons to smile, my Baby Yen. I want to make more happy memories with you, treat your heart with more care, and keep showing you how much you mean to me. Not just through words, but through the way I love you every day.

Thank you for being here, for the memories we've made, for the laughs, the hugs, the silly moments, and for being my person. I know we still have so much to learn and experience together. I want to keep growing with you and make the next chapters even sweeter.

Two years down, and I still choose you. Here's to many more ups, my love. ♡

I love you, Baby Yen. More than words can say.

MADE WITH LOVE · 二周年おめでとう · ♡
